Pumpwise
Predictive maintenance for small-factory motors and pumps
Pre-seed | Raising INR 2.2 Cr | Pune

A pump failure stops the whole line
Pumpwise 3
Breakdowns halt
production
A failed pump at a small plant
stops work for 1 to 3 days.
Monitoring costs too
much
Imported condition monitors
cost INR 40,000+ per motor,
with annual contracts.
Checks are by hand
Technicians do weekly rounds,
so failures are found after
they happen.
From visits to 38 plants in the Pune and Coimbatore clusters, Nov 2025 to Feb 2026.

Why now
Pumpwise 4
Cheap sensors
Vibration and temperature
chips now cost under INR
1,200 a unit.
Cheap connectivity
Low-power radios and Indian
mobile data make remote
monitoring affordable.
Small-data models
A model can learn a motor's
normal pattern in 2 weeks,
with no failure history.

Clip on, learn, alert
Pumpwise 5
1
Clip on
Fit a sensor on the motor in 10
minutes. No wiring.
2
Learn
The model learns normal
vibration and heat over 14 days.
3
Alert
WhatsApp alert when behaviour
drifts, days before failure.
